name: Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories
old_description: Shore Customs is the Jersey Shore’s Premier Source for Professional Car & Truck Customization
about:
Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories operates in Ocean Township, New Jersey, serving the Jersey Shore region as a vehicle customization shop. The business focuses on professional car and truck customization, offering a range of installation and detailing services.

The shop provides services including 3M ceramic coating, window tinting, paint protection film, auto detailing, audio and electronics installation, remote start systems, lift kits, rim repairs, vinyl wraps, and truck accessories such as tonneau covers, bed liners (Rhino Linings), and seating upgrades (Katzkin leather). They also offer powder coating, radar detectors, and weather protection products. Operations are conducted from a showroom facility where customers can view products and receive project reports detailing services performed.

Customers are primarily individual vehicle owners seeking customization for Jeeps, trucks, and daily drivers. The shop caters to off-road enthusiasts with lift kits and Front Runner outfitting, as well as truck owners needing towing accessories, shelving, and bed protection. They also serve clients looking for interior upgrades like heated leather seats and remote start systems.

The company emphasizes transparent communication and step-by-step work processes, providing clients with detailed project reports and a satisfaction guarantee. Financing options up to $10,000 are available for larger projects.

name: Sider's Woodcrafting
old_description: Please contact us if you cannot find what you are looking for!
about:
Sider's Woodcrafting operates from a home-based workshop in Brewer, Maine. The company was founded in October 2015 by Bruce and Mary Graybill after the birth of their first child prompted Bruce to start making cutting boards as holiday gifts using a table saw and belt sander. What began as a personal project quickly expanded when a friend requested eleven more boards, turning the effort into a family-owned business.

The workshop produces handcrafted end-grain chopping blocks, cutting boards in various sizes, charcuterie boards, specialty shapes such as cribbage boards and guitar-shaped boards, and epoxy-resin coasters and clipboards. Each piece is made from a mix of domestic and exotic woods chosen to highlight natural color and grain, with epoxy accents using SUPERCLEAR epoxy. In its first full year of operation (2016), the shop completed just under 400 boards.

The company sells directly to consumers through its online store, serving home cooks, gift buyers, and woodworking enthusiasts. Products range from small cheese boards to two-foot-long "mega" cutting boards, with designs that double as functional kitchen tools and decorative items.

The Graybills emphasize that every item leaves their shop as a functional work of art, backed by a commitment to stand behind their craftsmanship. The business grew from a desire to create everyday objects that showcase the beauty of wood while maintaining a hands-on, small-scale approach.

name: Sierra Components Inc
old_description: Sierra Components adds Component Design, Packaging and more to our list of services.
about:
Sierra Components Inc. (SCI) was founded in 1992 in Minden, Nevada, as a small family-run business. The company began with only a fax machine, a flow hood, and several nitrogen boxes, and has since grown into a multi-million-dollar distribution and processing facility specializing in silicon wafers and bare die. The president and founder brings over 40 years of bare-die distribution experience and 42-plus years in the microelectronics industry.

Today SCI operates as a value-added processor and distributor for the microelectronics and semiconductor sectors. Its services include visual inspection to MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 and MIL-STD-750 Methods 2072/2073, element evaluation and lot qualification to MIL-PRF-38534D (Levels H and K) and MIL-PRF-19500, alternate sourcing for obsolete or unavailable components, and wafer processing such as SAW sorting, inspection, and wafer probing. The company also manages surplus inventory programs that guarantee customers at least 50 percent of book value. A partnership with Kooker Technologies extends the offering to component design, packaging, and substrate fabrication with fast turnaround times.

SCI serves customers in the microelectronics, semiconductor, and defense-related industries that require qualified bare die, silicon wafers, and rigorous inspection and qualification services. Its client base includes organizations needing MIL-STD and MIL-PRF compliant processing, alternate component research, and inventory recovery solutions.

The company emphasizes personal service—no automated attendants—and a commitment to the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer attention. Its positioning as “large enough to accomplish the task, and small enough to deliver personal attention” reflects a deliberate focus on responsive, relationship-driven support.

name: Sierra Peaks Corporation
old_description: Building creative engineering and manufacturing solutions for every customer
about:
Sierra Peaks Corporation is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, with additional facilities in Fairfax, Virginia, and Lemon Grove, California. The company has been designing, engineering, and manufacturing unique system solutions for more than 40 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in available sources.

The company operates over 50,000 square feet of combined manufacturing and program management space across its three locations. Its capabilities span full-service machining, welding, electromechanical assembly, modeling, sewing, custom cable fabrication, and inspection simulations, supported by in-house mechanical, electrical, systems, and software engineering teams. Sierra Peaks also provides rapid prototyping, first-article production, and project management services, delivering projects on schedule and within budget.

Sierra Peaks serves the defense, intelligence, aerospace, maritime, energy, audio, and research sectors, including national security programs. Its customer base includes government and commercial clients requiring highly customized hardware and software solutions. Representative products include aerostructures and automated test equipment, alongside standard product lines that can be tailored to specific needs.

The company differentiates itself through NISPOM-compliant facilities cleared for restricted programs, end-to-end project management, and the ability to engage at any project phase—from initial concept through production. Its engineers emphasize designing for manufacturability and functionality, aiming to deliver exactly what each customer envisions.

name: Silkhands Inc.
old_description: we have helped independent and emerging designers create fashion. We specialize in Quality and Efficiency and are 100% made in Los Angeles.
about:
Silkhands Inc. was founded in 2006 in Los Angeles, California. The company operates a fashion development and production facility in the city's garment district.

The company provides end-to-end apparel manufacturing services, including pattern making, sampling, cutting, grading, marker making, and full production runs. Its in-house team handles everything from initial pattern development through finishing, which includes trimming, dual inspections, pressing, steaming, folding, bagging, labeling, and boxing. The facility works with a wide range of fabrics and produces categories such as men's and women's apparel, swimwear, underwear, lingerie, and children's wear.

Silkhands primarily serves independent and emerging fashion designers who need a domestic production partner. Clients range from startups launching first collections to established labels requiring small-to-medium volume runs. The company's service packages bundle patterns, samples, fittings, and adjustments to streamline the pre-production process.

Silkhands emphasizes that all work is performed in its Los Angeles factory by its own staff, a model it says ensures quality control and efficiency. Standard production lead times are quoted at four to eight weeks, with a 50 percent deposit due at contract signing and the balance on delivery.

name: Simcona Electronics Corporation
old_description: sourcing, inventory management, or control panel manufacturing challenges
about:
Simcona Electronics Corporation was founded in 1962 by Louis Iacona and Simon Braitman in Rochester, New York. The pair opened an 1,800-square-foot loft opposite Kodak Park as a component distribution company. The business remains family-owned and operated, transitioning to second-generation leadership in 1999 and sole ownership under Marc Iacona in 2011.

Today Simcona operates as both an electronic component distributor and a contract manufacturer of industrial control panels. Its 130,000-square-foot footprint spans three facilities in Rochester and supports a staff of more than 70. The company maintains a network of over 200 component suppliers and offers build-to-print panel manufacturing certified to UL 508A and UL 698, with capabilities ranging from single prototypes to high-mix, scalable production runs. Services also include prototyping, design-for-manufacturing support, kitting, inventory management, and 100% functional testing under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Customers span aerospace, healthcare, military and defense, data infrastructure, commercial entertainment, general industrial, and oil and gas sectors. Testimonials reference clients in each of these verticals, and the company's blog highlights fiber-optic applications for the oil and gas industry. Simcona primarily serves the eastern United States.

Simcona emphasizes long-term relationships and invests heavily in workforce development, requiring Lean Six Sigma belts for operations and engineering staff, along with project management and UL 508A certifications. The company cites its purpose-built facilities, AI-enabled sourcing tools, and a culture of caring, collaboration, passion, loyalty, innovation, and integrity as key differentiators.
